items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: You remember Willie Jackson? Willie Jackson? Yeah. Willie Jackson used to sing.

ctx.x: Ask him if he knows. Do you know the words to a number called, Maestres Wagon, Done Been Here and Gone? I didn't think I knew that. That's about the old male, you know. Oh, yeah. And his furniture wagon used to come around and take all the beds back. Oh, yeah. I knew it wasn't.

Well, that was down the line, you know. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. Oh, Lewis Armstrong used to come out with a whole lot of funny songs, too, you know. Who? Lewis Armstrong. Oh, yeah. And Cat Gallery. Willie Jackson. You remember Willie Jackson? Willie Jackson? Yeah. Willie Jackson used to sing. Yeah.
